detail: reproit doctor no longer reports MISSING and fails its run when the Playwright web runner's node_modules are not installed yet. The runner installs its own dependencies on the first reproit find or init (ensure_web_runner_dir runs npm ci), so a runner directory that carries a package.json is self-provisioning. Doctor now reports the playwright package check as ok with a note that it installs automatically on first run, and only the separately-checked node prerequisite remains a hard failure. This stops a fresh cargo install from showing a required-check failure for a state the system fixes itself on first use.
